standard.coverage: All employers, regardless of size -- California's 25-or-fewer-employee tier ended after 2022.
standard.note: Labor Code 1182.12 annual CPI adjustment, capped at 3.5%. 2027: $17.40 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Labor Code 351 -- tips are the sole property of the employee and may never be credited against the minimum wage. California has the largest tipped-worker exposure of any no-tip-credit state.

knownGaps: California has more local minimum wage ordinances than the rest of the country combined -- 38 of them, in local/CA-local-2026.json.
California also runs two SECTORAL minimum wages well above the state rate (fast food, health care) -- see sectoral/CA-sectoral-2026.json.

Exempt-employee salary thresholds (2x the state minimum wage annualized) and the separate computer-professional and licensed-physician exemptions are derived from, but not the same as, this rate; they are out of scope here.
